source_folds: leave FactorShock out and train on Queue only; leave Queue out and train on FactorShock only; encoder, dictionary and all four priors fitted without the heldout task
adaptation: first raw replicate at the first four archived policy sites only; no sample variance or heldout remainder enters fitting, weights or recommendation
roster_rule: start with the four paid sites, then add highest-ranked distinct primary policies until six; ranking uses the joint mixture's complete64-policy terminal class at362 calls,512 Sobol nodes,80701 seed; freeze retained policy as this pre-score best primary
terminal_class: same guarded/direct class, paid empirical supports, retained-policy extension, alpha/delta and hard total cap; source archive policies rather than a new frontend experiment
control: direct certification of pre-score retained primary using min128/cap-minus-four calls; policy fixed across budgets and independent of scoring truth
freeze_order: freeze all folds, rosters, retained policies and40 terminal choices before querying any heldout source scoring truth; never construct or score the Inventory target
endpoints: predicted-minus-true conditional terminal reward/calls; true loss to the best action in the frozen terminal class; comparison to fixed retained direct; per-component and common-identity results
attribution: at the already frozen mixture and fixed-control actions only, replace g mean, eta_g, both constraint heads, or both objective heads by heldout scoring truth; other marginal draws and original shared identity weights remain fixed; this is a diagnostic substitution, not a posterior update, reranking or deployable algorithm
precision: 8192-node same-action marginal integration; retain first choices; if a tested discrepancy of the attribution integration changes the conclusion, fix that implementation before interpreting; no result-dependent task additions or target tuning
execution: local serial single-thread; reuse384 archived source calls,16 fits as before,40 frozen choices and16 selected-action attributions;0 new simulations or certificates, no server work or pulls
scope: two fixed source laws with one other law for training per fold; source-terminal decision calibration, not independent deployment confirmation, frontend60/60 reproduction or general source-prior superiority
